steps.message:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-04 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 4201.4 | 5.06 | 5.06
2 | 2238.9 | 4.35 | 9.41
3 | 343.9 | 31.91 | 41.32
4 | 25.0 | 0.99 | 42.31
5 | 10.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as H-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: T-04
Curve type: Q (QQQ) — recalculated from the resistivity sequence (4201.4 > 2238.9 > 343.9 > 25.0 > 10.9, monotonically decreasing); this corrects the file's H-type label, which does not match the data.
Aquifer depth: 41.32 m to 42.31 m and below (low-resistivity zone of 25.0 ohm-m underlain by 10.9 ohm-m layer of unconstrained thickness)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to at least 42.5–45 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity (25.0/10.9 ohm-m) interval beginning at 41.32 m, as this is the most probable water-bearing zone; confirm lithology and water strikes against this depth and flag the curve-type discrepancy for re-review before finalizing well design.
